name: opencode-config
//: Keep the versions in sync with the installed OpenCode host, so the types are correct!
* @opentui/core with the OpenTUI version OpenCode bundles
note: A mismatched @opentui/core loads as a second instance beside the host's own, and
the colors it builds cross into the host renderer.
warn: A mismatched @opencode/plugin costs nothing at runtime and merely blinds the types.
